title: ZCC user privacy (web privacy): what the app collects and exposes

prose.text: User Privacy is one tenant-wide settings object that decides what end-user and device data Client Connector collects and who on the device can reach logs and packet capture. {{purpose}} {{api-object}}
What each setting does: [[zcc.web-privacy.collection]]. Reading and writing it through the API and SDKs: [[zcc.api.web-privacy-wire]].

prose.label: Not here.
prose.text: {{separate-app-supportability}} {{app-supportability-no-api}} The mapping is [[zcc.support-options:field-ui-mapping]]; the settings themselves are in [[zcc.logging.user-access]] and [[zcc.support-options]]. How verbose the app's own logs are is set per app profile: [[zcc.app-profiles.logging]].

purpose.statement: User Privacy settings let an organization comply with GDPR by turning collection of device owner and machine hostname on or off, enable packet capture and non-administrator access to log files, restrict packet capture to administrators, stop automatic crash report uploads, collect location for ZDX-enabled devices, let users override Z-Tunnel 2.0 or Private Access protocol settings, and enforce secure PAC URLs.

quotes: Comply with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) by disabling or enabling the collection of device owner and machine hostname information.
Enable packet capture and allow non-administrator users access to log files for troubleshooting.
Restrict packet capture to only administrators.
Protect user information by disabling automatic uploading of crash reports.
Collect geolocation information if Digital Experience (ZDX) is enabled on a device.
Provide users flexibility by allowing them to change default parameters for Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0 or Private Access protocol settings.
Protect traffic from malicious PAC files by enforcing secure PAC URLs.

purpose.conditions: Quote added for the protocol override clause (verifier w2 E4).

api-object.statement: In the API the object is web privacy information, "the configuration information for end user and device-related PII", read and written as one object.

expect.description: Gets the configuration information for end user and device-related PII.
Adds or updates the configuration information for end user and device-related PII.

separate-app-supportability.statement: Whether users can see where logs are stored, export or clear logs, change the log mode, or use Report an Issue is set on a different page, App Supportability.

quotes: From the App Supportability page, you can configure your users
If you keep logging controls visible on Zscaler Client Connector, your users can:
See where encrypted logs are stored on their devices by clicking Show/Hide Logs in the Report an Issue form.
From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > App Supportability.
Hide Logging Control on Zscaler Client Connector: Prevents users from exporting or clearing logs and changing the Log Mode set by the Zscaler admin using App Profiles.
Enable Support Access in Zscaler Client Connector: Allows users to access the Report an Issue form.

separate-app-supportability.conditions: Quote added for the Report an Issue clause (verifier w2 E5).

app-supportability-no-api.statement: App Supportability settings are not in the web privacy object; by name they are company-info fields.
app-supportability-no-api.conditions: Restated (verifier w2 E3): the earlier claim that the API has no operation for these settings is contradicted by the company-info mapping. The absence from the web privacy body is pinned; the company-info side is a name match.
